```{r}
#| include: false
# Data comes from firm_roles_to_csv.R. Re-render after re-running it.
roles <- read.csv("smf_roles.csv", colClasses = "character", encoding = "UTF-8")
roles <- roles[startsWith(roles$smf_role, "SMF"), ]

# Order roles SMF1, SMF2, ..., SMF20, SMF20a by number, then letter suffix.
role_num <- as.integer(sub("^SMF(\\d+).*", "\\1", roles$smf_role))
role_suffix <- sub("^SMF\\d+([a-z]*).*", "\\1", roles$smf_role)
roles$role_rank <- match(
  roles$smf_role,
  unique(roles$smf_role[order(role_num, role_suffix, roles$smf_role)])
)
roles <- roles[order(tolower(roles$firm_name), roles$role_rank, roles$name), ]
ojs_define(roles_raw = roles)

# The download button serves the file exactly as on disk, not the filtered view.
csv_text <- readChar("smf_roles.csv", file.size("smf_roles.csv"), useBytes = TRUE)
Encoding(csv_text) <- "UTF-8"
ojs_define(roles_csv = csv_text)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
data = transpose(roles_raw)
uniq = (xs) => Array.from(new Set(xs)).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))

// Styling below follows the ifoa_practising_certificates dashboard.

// One summary figure per card: a one-line label, then a Bootstrap icon beside
// the large value. The value shrinks on narrow screens so it is never clipped.
statBox = (icon, label, value) => htl.html`<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 0 4px; min-width: 0;">
  <style>
    body { --stat-accent: #2a78d6; }
    body.quarto-dark { --stat-accent: #3987e5; }
  </style>
  <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.8; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;" title=${label}>${label}</div>
  <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;">
    <i class="bi bi-${icon}" style="font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--stat-accent);" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    <span style="font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.4vw, 1.6rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap;">${value.toLocaleString()}</span>
  </div>
</div>`

noSelectStyle = htl.html`<style>
  /* Hide the row-selection checkboxes Inputs.table adds as its first column. */
  .no-select table { width: 100%; }
  .no-select thead th { white-space: normal; word-break: normal; overflow-wrap: normal; vertical-align: bottom; }
  .no-select table tr > :first-child { display: none; }
  /* Highlight the row under the pointer. */
  .no-select table tbody tr:hover td { background: rgba(127, 127, 127, 0.15); }
</style>`

// Redraws its content to fill the card. It measures the card's output area
// (which Quarto sizes to the card) and positions the content absolutely, so
// the content can't change the size being measured.
fillCard = function(draw) {
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "position: relative; width: 100%; height: 260px;";
  const inner = document.createElement("div");
  inner.style.cssText = "position: absolute; inset: 0;";
  container.append(inner);
  let frame;
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const width = Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width);
      const height = Math.max(260, Math.floor(entry.contentRect.height) - 4);
      container.style.height = `${height}px`;
      if (width > 0) inner.replaceChildren(draw(width, height));
    });
  });
  (function attach() {
    if (!container.isConnected) return requestAnimationFrame(attach);
    observer.observe(container.closest(".cell-output") ?? container);
  })();
  return container;
}

// Role choices follow the firm filter, so only roles that exist show.
byFirm = data.filter(d => firm === "All firms" || d.firm_name === firm)
roleChoices = {
  const rank = new Map(byFirm.map(d => [d.smf_role, d.role_rank]));
  return [...rank.keys()].sort((a, b) => rank.get(a) - rank.get(b));
}

filtered = {
  const q = person.trim().toLowerCase();
  return byFirm.filter(d =>
    (role === "All roles" || d.smf_role === role) &&
    (q === "" ||
      d.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.individual_ref.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.individual_id.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
}
```

# {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof firm = Inputs.select(["All firms", ...uniq(data.map(d => d.firm_name))], {
  label: "Firm"
})
viewof role = Inputs.select(["All roles", ...roleChoices], {label: "Role"})
viewof person = Inputs.text({
  label: "Individual",
  placeholder: "Name, reference or id"
})
```

```{ojs}
// A themed Bootstrap button, so it stays visible in light and dark mode.
{
  const button = htl.html`<button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm w-100 btn-quarto">Download full CSV</button>`;
  button.onclick = () => {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob([roles_csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"})
    );
    const a = htl.html`<a href=${url} download="smf_roles.csv">`;
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  };
  return button;
}
```

Downloads every row of `smf_roles.csv`, ignoring the filters above.

Data: [FCA Financial Services Register](https://register.fca.org.uk/s/), individuals currently involved with each firm.

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "SMF roles"
fillCard((width, height) => htl.html`<div class="no-select">${noSelectStyle}
  ${Inputs.table(filtered, {
    height,
    // Render every row up front: lazy loading on scroll doesn't trigger inside dashboard cards.
    rows: filtered.length + 1,
    columns: ["firm_name", "smf_role", "name", "individual_id"],
    header: {
      firm_name: "Firm",
      smf_role: "Role",
      name: "Name",
      individual_id: "Individual id"
    },
    // Fixed widths keep every column on screen; the last takes any spare width.
    width: {firm_name: 280, smf_role: 280, name: 200},
    layout: "fixed"
  })}</div>`)
```
